title: Cybersecurity in the Intelligence Age
summary: OpenAI outlines a five-part action plan for strengthening cybersecurity in the Intelligence Age, focused on democratizing AI-powered cyber defense and protecting critical systems.
body: OpenAI outlines a five-part action plan for strengthening cybersecurity in the Intelligence Age, focused on democratizing AI-powered cyber defense and protecting critical systems.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了关于“智能时代”网络安全的五点行动计划，重点在于普及AI驱动的网络防御能力。该内容主要为政策性倡议，未涉及具体模型技术或安全架构的实现细节。
